text: ansys-agent-bridge 是把 Ansys SpaceClaim 几何操作接入 DSH 的 MCP 工具包，通过一个 MCP 客户端层注册服务器。它能检测本机 Ansys 环境、启动或连接 SpaceClaim 会话、读取和检查 CAD 几何、创建管体与拉伸实体，并执行布尔操作、变换及多种格式导出；修改操作会核验几何是否实际变化。适合需要用 DSH agent 检查或处理 SpaceClaim 模型的工程工作流。需要 Windows、Ansys SpaceClaim 和 uv；默认启动配置从 GitHub 获取服务代码。

ansys-agent-bridge connects DSH to SpaceClaim through MCP. It inspects CAD geometry, creates pipes and extrusions, applies boolean operations, and exports models. Changes are verified from geometry measurements. For agent-assisted CAD work. Requires Windows, Ansys SpaceClaim, and uv.

ansys-agent-bridge 的功能「几何环境诊断」：调用 ansys_bridge_doctor，返回检测到的 Ansys 版本、SpaceClaim 和 Fluent 路径、Python 及依赖版本，供启动前检查本机环境。
ansys-agent-bridge 的功能「几何检查」：调用 scdm_inspect_geometry 检查当前设计的重复面、短边、小面等几何状况，并返回检测结果供定位问题。
ansys-agent-bridge 的功能「创建管体」：调用 scdm_create_pipe，输入外径、长度及可选内径和轴向，在当前设计中创建空心管或实心杆，并校验截面与挤出体积。
ansys-agent-bridge 的功能「导出 CAD 文件」：调用 scdm_export 并指定格式及输出文件名，将当前设计导出为 SCdocx、STEP、IGES、Parasolid 或 PMDB 文件。

ansys-agent-bridge README · ansys-agent-bridge：An MCP server that drives **Ansys SpaceClaim** headlessly, plus a **DSH plugin
bundle** that installs it into a DeepSeek Harness profile in one command.

ansys-agent-bridge README · ansys-agent-bridge：The point of this project is not to wrap every API. It is to report what
SpaceClaim actually did, in a place where the honest answer matters: two
operations on SpaceClaim 2024 R2 **return success and change nothing**, and an
agent that believes the return value will confidently describe geometry that
was never modified. This server measures the geometry before and after, and
raises `no_geometry_change` instead of reporting a success it cannot see.

ansys-agent-bridge README · What it does：| Tool | Read-only | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `ansys_bridge_doctor` | yes | Reports detected Ansys releases, `SpaceClaim.exe`, Fluent root, Python, and package versions. Imports nothing heavyweight. |
| `scdm_session_start` | no | Starts a SpaceClaim modeler (auto-detects the release; measured **14–31 s**). `hidden=false` by default, so you see the window. |
| `scdm_attach` | no | Connects to a SpaceClaim the **user** started (ApiServer add-in + fixed `API_PORT`). Consumes no licence, and cannot close their window. |
| `scdm_session_status` | yes | Whether a session is live, its mode, and whether a design is visible to it. |
| `scdm_session_close` | no | Releases the session and its licence. Launch sessions only; refused when attached. |
| `scdm_detach` | no | Drops the gRPC channel to a user-owned SpaceClaim. Nothing else. |
| `scdm_open_file` | no | Opens `.scdoc`/`.scdocx`/`.dsco`/`.pmdb` and reports bodies, named selections, face counts, volumes. |
| `scdm_list_bodies` | yes | Body names, face counts, volumes for the open design. |
| `scdm_collisions` | yes | Pairwise collision state (`TOUCH`/`NONE`/…), all pairs or a chosen list.

every one either read the model or operated on bodies that already existed, so
"model from scratch" meant hand-writing IronPython. The route the creation tools use
was measured, and it deliberately contains **no boolean**:

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · a ring section built from two semicircles per circle, then extruded：Why not subtract a rod from a rod: on this kernel `Body.subtract` returns normally,
deletes the tool body and leaves the target untouched. And why **read the result
back**: `removeInnerRegions=False` does not fail — it drops the inner loop silently
and hands back a plain outer disc (`1963.495 mm²` where the ring is `706.858 mm²`),
so an unguarded tool builds a solid rod and reports a tube. `scdm_create_pipe`
checks the section area and the volume against the analytic values and refuses
anything else.

ansys-agent-bridge README · a ring section built from two semicircles per circle, then extruded：Measured live, over MCP: a 50/40/200 mm pipe came back with 4 faces and
`141367.72 mm³` against an analytic `141371.67 mm³`; a 20/10/30 mm pipe with
`7068.394 mm³` against `7068.583 mm³`; an extrusion of a `235.6194 mm²` annulus by
5 mm added `1178.081 mm³` against an analytic `1178.097 mm³`.

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · The two silent failures, measured：On a stator + 27 windings + pipe + inlet assembly (31 bodies, 846 faces):

**`subtract` fails, and the failure is easy to miss.** Target stator: 382 faces
and volume `0.003314505208 m³` before; **382 faces and the same volume after**.
The only thing that moved is the body count, 31 → 30, because `keep_other=False`
deleted the tool.

ansys-agent-bridge README · The two silent failures, measured：That matters for how you guard it. The obvious check — "did anything change?" —
answers *yes* here, so a guard built on it certifies the no-op. This server
therefore judges a boolean by **its target**: if the named target keeps the same
face count and volume, the call failed, whatever the body count says. The same
symptom appears through raw IronPython `Shape.Subtract`, so it is a
kernel/geometry problem with that model, not an API-path problem.

ansys-agent-bridge README · The two silent failures, measured：**`share_topology` returns `True` and does nothing.** Stator stays at 382 faces,
winding 1 at 16, bodies at 31.

**`unite` does work.** Stator faces `382 → 390`, volume
`0.003314505208 → 0.003382973513` (delta `6.84683e-5`, exactly winding 1's own
volume), total faces `846 → 838`, bodies `31 → 30`. Both number sets match the
raw IronPython result.

ansys-agent-bridge README · The two silent failures, measured：Full measured record, including the raw-IronPython traps (`Body[](n)` is a
parse-time error that kills a script silently; `Document.Load` breaks every
later `SaveAs`), is in [`spaceclaim/skills/ansys-spaceclaim/SKILL.md`](spaceclaim/skills/ansys-spaceclaim/SKILL.md).

ansys-agent-bridge README · One trap before you build the CAD: Chinese names do not reach Fluent：Measured when a SpaceClaim STEP was imported into Fluent Meshing: the import printed
`Warning: ?????????` and **all three named collections were dropped**, leaving the
mesh with no usable named selections. The geometry arrived; the names did not.
section: One trap before you build the CAD: Chinese names do not reach Fluent

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · One trap before you build the CAD: Chinese names do not reach Fluent：So name layers and named selections in **ASCII** — `inlet`, `outlet`, `wall`,
`fluid` — if the model is going to Fluent. Named selections are what every
downstream boundary-condition assignment depends on, and they are cheap to get
right at the CAD step and expensive to redo later.

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Install：Requires **Windows**, an Ansys installation with SpaceClaim (2024 R2 tested),
and [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).

ansys-agent-bridge README · Three ways to install：There are three supported ways to install this in DSH. A and B differ only in
**where the MCP server is loaded from**; C installs the launcher once and then
starts it from PATH, so **`uv` resolves nothing at launch**:

ansys-agent-bridge README · Three ways to install：| | Option A: install from GitHub | Option B: install from a local checkout | Option C: install the launcher into PATH |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plugin package | `github:1622352030/ansys-agent-bridge` | `link:<path to your clone>` | same as A or B — C replaces only the MCP row |
| MCP launch source | `git+https://github.com/…#subdirectory=spaceclaim/python` | `<clone>/spaceclaim/python` | the installed console script `ansys-bridge-mcp` (no `uv`, no path) |
| Network needed per launch | **yes** (a `git fetch` first) | **no** GitHub fetch; the PyPI index may be consulted when the environment is (re)materialised | **only once, at install time** |
| Dependency resolution per launch | every launch | every launch, and any change under `<clone>/spaceclaim/python` re-materialises the environment | none — resolved once by `uv tool install` |
| No VPN / GitHub unreachable | ⚠ fails, and can take the whole desktop app down | fine | fine |
| After editing this repo | reinstall required | takes effect immediately | takes effect immediately, with no re-resolution and no rebuild |
| Tracks upstream automatically | yes | no | no |
| Undoing it

ansys-agent-bridge README · Three ways to install：**If you are behind an unreliable route to GitHub, use Option B.** When Option A's
`git fetch` fails, the bundled `failOnStartupError: false` hides the error, and the
automatic reconnect loop rebuilds the environment and re-imports
`ansys.geometry.core` / `ansys.fluent.core` over and over, saturating DSH's
single-threaded host event loop — every session history sits at "loading" and the
desktop stops responding. The plugin manager then decides that enabling it "would
persist a state that crashes at boot" and **latches it as disabled**, after which
the UI switch will not bring it back. Mechanism, diagnostics and the unlock
procedure: [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](./TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

ansys-agent-bridge README · Option A: install from GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ansys-agent-bridge
```

That installs the package, which declares `dsh.bundle`, so the loader applies
its `cordis.patch.yml`: one MCP client layer registering the `ansys` server.
Restart the profile and call `ansys_bridge_doctor`.

Turning it off again is the same in reverse:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove ansys-agent-bridge
```

ansys-agent-bridge README · Option A: install from GitHub：The MCP row launches the server with `uv tool run --from <this repo>`, so no
clone and no virtualenv is needed on the target machine — but the **first**
call pays for resolving and building `ansys-geometry-core`. If you keep a local
checkout and want a warm environment instead, use **Option B** below — note the
path is `<clone>/spaceclaim/python` (the Python package lives under `spaceclaim/`);
the older `<clone>/python` form no longer applies.

ansys-agent-bridge README · Option B: install from a local checkout：Two steps: point the plugin at your local directory, then override the MCP row's
launch source with a `--patch` overlay.

```sh
section: Option B: install from a local checkout

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · 1) point the plugin package at your local clone：dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/ansys-agent-bridge
```

```yaml
section: 1) point the plugin package at your local clone

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · %APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml：- id: mcp-ansys
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: ansys
    transport: stdio
    command: uv
    args:
      - 'tool'
      - 'run'
      - '--quiet'
      - '--from'
      - 'C:/path/to/ansys-agent-bridge/spaceclaim/python'
      - 'ansys-bridge-mcp'
    env:
      PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8'
      ANSYS_BRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL: 'WARNING'
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 900000
    failOnStartupError: false
```

Restart DSH for it to take effect.

ansys-agent-bridge README · Option C: install the launcher into PATH：Option B still hands every launch to `uv tool run`, which resolves dependencies and
re-materialises the isolated environment each time — and redoes that work from
scratch whenever anything under `<clone>/spaceclaim/python` changes (editing
`src/…`, for one). Install the launcher **once** instead, and let DSH start a plain
command:

```sh
uv tool install --editable --from <clone>/spaceclaim/python ansys-agent-bridge
```
section: Option C: install the launcher into PATH

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Option C: install the launcher into PATH：> ✅ Re-verified 2026-10-17: `uv tool list` reports `ansys-agent-bridge v0.1.0` with **both**
> console scripts (`ansys-bridge-doctor`, `ansys-bridge-mcp`), and `ansys-bridge-mcp`
> completes a real MCP `initialize` handshake over stdin (`protocolVersion` plus the full
> tool list on stdout) — the install is not just on paper.
section: Option C: install the launcher into PATH

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Option C: install the launcher into PATH：The positional argument is the **package name** (`[project].name` in
`pyproject.toml`), **not** the command name. `uv` rejects the command-name form
itself, with no room for interpretation:
`error: Package name (ansys-agent-bridge) provided with --from does not match install request (ansys-bridge-mcp)`.
section: Option C: install the launcher into PATH

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Option C: install the launcher into PATH：That installs an editable tool environment and puts the console scripts on PATH —
on Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\ansys-bridge-mcp.exe`, and `uv tool dir --bin`
prints the exact directory. If that directory is on PATH, the DSH override becomes a
**bare command name, with no path and no `uv`**:

```yaml

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · %APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml：- id: mcp-ansys
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: ansys
    transport: stdio
    command: ansys-bridge-mcp
    args: []
    env:
      PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8'
      ANSYS_BRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL: 'WARNING'
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 900000
    failOnStartupError: false
```

`--editable` points the installed environment at `<clone>/spaceclaim/python/src`, so
`uv`'s own help describes it as "changes in the package's source directory aresh

ansys-agent-bridge README · Why the patch has neither `!!js` nor an absolute path：That is deliberate: the harness CLI (0.1.1-rc.1) evaluates `!!js` in a scope without
`createRequire` and does not await the result, so an expression using either boots on
the Desktop app (0.1.5-rc.2) and leaves the CLI with a profile that will not start.
Both were tried and both broke it; `command: uv` needs neither. Override that one
line if `uv` is not on the PATH the harness was launched with:

```yaml
    command: C:/Users/you/.local/bin/uv.exe
```
section: Why the patch has neither `!!js` nor an absolute path

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · The bundled skill：The same `!!js` restriction is why `spaceclaim/skills/ansys-spaceclaim/` is **not** wired up
by the patch. Registering it needs a path resolved at load time, which needs one
of the two constructs above. Add it explicitly instead, in your profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` (next to the bundle's) — this runs inside the host, where
`dshHomePath` is always available and no module resolution is involved:

ansys-agent-bridge README · The bundled skill：```sh
mkdir -p "$DSH_HOME/skills"                      # or %APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\skills
cp -r <repo>/spaceclaim/skills/ansys-spaceclaim "$DSH_HOME/skills/"
```

`$DSH_HOME/skills` is one of the host's default skill roots, so nothing else is
needed. Without it the MCP tools still work; what you lose is the measured
operating notes and the trap list.

ansys-agent-bridge README · Any other MCP client：The server is a plain stdio MCP server, so it is not tied to DSH. Generate the
block for your client:

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/1622352030/ansys-agent-bridge#subdirectory=spaceclaim/python" \
    ansys-bridge-doctor --config claude    # also: cursor, vscode, dsh
```

ansys-agent-bridge README · Any other MCP client：Use `uv tool run`, not `uv run`: measured against uv 0.11.29, `uv run` rejects
`--from` with `unexpected argument '--from' found`, and the MCP client shows
only `Connection closed`.

ansys-agent-bridge README · Environment variables：| Variable | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_UV` | — | Not read by the patch (which has no `!!js`). Override the `command:` line with a `--patch` overlay if `uv` is not on PATH. |
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_PRELOAD` | `1` | Import the Ansys clients at start-up. Set `0` for a fast start; the first SpaceClaim call then pays that import. |
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_TRANSPORT` | `stdio` | `stdio`, `sse`, or `streamable-http`. |
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL` | `WARNING` | FastMCP request logging. `INFO` logs one line per request. |

ansys-agent-bridge README · Why start-up preloads, and why tools are serialised：FastMCP runs a synchronous tool **on the event loop thread**
(`mcp/server/fastmcp/utilities/func_metadata.py`: `return fn(**args)` — there is
no `to_thread`). Lazy-importing `ansys.geometry.core` from inside a tool call
was measured wedging the whole process inside numpy's C extension
`create_module`, **with no exception and no timeout** — the client sees a tool
call that simply never returns:
section: Why start-up preloads, and why tools are serialised

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Why start-up preloads, and why tools are serialised：```
_call_with_frames_removed (<frozen importlib._bootstrap>:488)
create_module (<frozen importlib._bootstrap_external>:1321)
<module> (numpy\_core\multiarray.py:11)
...

The identical import finishes in **0.9 s** at process start, so `main()`
imports numpy and both Ansys clients before accepting a request. Stacks were
captured with `py-spy dump`.
section: Why start-up preloads, and why tools are serialised

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Why start-up preloads, and why tools are serialised：The same fact means **long tools block the server**: a 30-second SpaceClaim
start holds the event loop, so a concurrent call queues behind it. That is
acceptable here — SpaceClaim mutates one design, and serialising is what you
want — but it is why `toolCallTimeoutMs` in the DSH patch is 900 s rather than
the 60 s default.
section: Why start-up preloads, and why tools are serialised

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Safety：- **Never open a file a SpaceClaim GUI has open, and never write to a source
  model.** Open, operate, export to a new path.
- A session holds a licence; call `scdm_session_close`.
- Package inspection is metadata-only. An earlier version imported
  `ansys.fluent.core` inside a tool call to read its version; that library
  prints during import, which corrupted the stdio JSON-RPC stream and killed
  the session mid-call. `package_version()` now reads metadata without
  importing.

ansys-agent-bridge README · Layout：The repository is split by product domain, strictly. SpaceClaim material and
Fluent material never share a directory, down to the test scripts:

```
package.json            DSH bundle manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`) + npm entry
cordis.patch.yml        the bundle's patch layer
TROUBLESHOOTING.md      desktop install / hang / MCP-will-not-re-enable, and how to unlock
screenshots.json

ansys-agent-bridge README · Layout：`dev/` holds development-time material and stays inside the repository on
purpose, so nothing is ever written into a user's model directory. Transcripts,
export dumps and the copied test models are gitignored; the test scripts and the
API inventories are kept.

The root keeps only what must be at the root: npm reads `package.json` there, and
`dsh.bundle.patch` resolves `./cordis.patch.yml` relative to it.

ansys-agent-bridge README · What is and is not implemented：[`spaceclaim/docs/feature-coverage.md`](spaceclaim/docs/feature-coverage.md) is the item-by-item
comparison against the official API: every capability domain, whether it is
implemented, and — for the gaps — why. It is not a list of what the server does;
it is the list a reader needs to find what it does not do.
section: What is and is not implemented

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · What is and is not implemented：The headline is that **the official client declares far more than this release
can run**. Of 286 public methods carrying a `@min_backend_version` gate, only
**15 are callable on 24R2**; the other 271 need 25.1 through 27.1. That includes
all 44 `GeometryCommands` modelling methods. The comparison therefore filters by
version first, which is what separates a real gap from a method that would only
raise `GeometryRuntimeError`.

Two consequences worth knowing before you plan work:
section: What is and is not implemented

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · What is and is not implemented：- **Geometric inspection is now the headline feature.** Eight `RepairTools.find_*`
  methods carry no version gate at all, so they work on 24R2, and all eight are
  behind `scdm_inspect_geometry`. On the assembly whose meshing failed, that tool
  names the cause: two pairs of coincident faces, one on `stator` and one on
  `pip` in each pair, with identical areas. Replacing "the mesh failed" with
  "these two faces are stacked" is the whole point.
- **An external flow enclosure cannot be built through this API.** The three
  `create_*_enclosure` methods need 26.1.0. For external-flow CFD, build the
  domain in the SpaceClaim UI or use Fluent Meshing's enclosure instead.
section: What is and is not implemented

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · Development：```sh
node tools/verify-patch.mjs        # no profile needed
uv run --directory python pytest -q
```

`verify-patch.mjs` evaluates any `!!js` expression in the patch inside a bare
`with (ctx) { eval(expr) }` scope — exactly what the CLI builds — and refuses a
promise result, so a patch that would only boot on the newer harness fails here
instead of on a user's machine. It also checks that the console script the patch
launches is the one `pyproject.toml` declares.

ansys-agent-bridge README · ansys-agent-bridge：一个驱动 **Ansys SpaceClaim** 的 MCP 服务器，外加一个 **DSH 插件包**——一条命令
把它装进 DeepSeek Harness 的 profile。

这个项目的重点不是把 API 逐个包一层，而是如实报告 SpaceClaim 到底做了什么。原因很
具体：SpaceClaim 2024 R2 上有两个操作会**返回成功却什么都没改**，而相信返回值的
agent 会一本正经地描述一个从未被修改过的几何体。这个服务器在操作前后测量几何，看
不到变化就抛 `no_geometry_change`，而不是报一个它验证不了的"成功"。

|---|---|---|
| `ansys_bridge_doctor` | 是 | 报告探测到的 Ansys 版本、`SpaceClaim.exe`、Fluent 根目录、Python 与依赖包版本。不导入任何重库。 |

| `scdm_detach` | 否 | 断开与用户 SpaceClaim 的连接：只关 gRPC 通道，进程与许可都不动。 |

ansys-agent-bridge README · 两个静默失效，实测数据：在"定子 + 27 个绕组 + 管 + 入口"这个装配体上：

**`subtract` 会失败。** 目标体积 `0.003314505208 m³`、382 个面；操作后体积与面数
**完全相同**，只有工具实体被删掉了（实体数 31 → 30）。用原生 IronPython
`Shape.Subtract` 得到同样的症状，说明这是该模型的几何/内核问题，不是 API 路径问题。

**`share_topology` 返回 `True` 却什么都没做。** 定子仍是 382 面，绕组 1 仍是 16 面，
实体数仍是 31。

**`unite` 是真的生效。** 定子体积 `0.003314505208 → 0.003382973513`（增量
`6.84683e-5`，正好等于绕组 1 自身体积），面数 `382 → 390`，与原生 IronPython 结果
一致。

| | `mode=launch`（我控） | `mode=attach`（你控） |
|---|---|---|
| 工具 | `scdm_session_start` | `scdm_attach` |
| 谁启动的进程 | 本服务器 | 用户 |
| 许可 | 本服务器占一份 | **不新增**，复用用户那份 |
| `process_ownership.owner` | `ai` | `user` |
| 怎么结束 | `scdm_session_close` | `scdm_detach`（只关通道） |
| 另一个工具 | `scdm_detach` → **被拒** | `scdm_session_close` → **被拒** |

ansys-agent-bridge README · 我控：默认就是看得见的窗口：`hidden` 默认 `false`。实测（走真实 MCP stdio 传输）：返回
`mode="launch"`／`ui_visible=true`，**21.8 s** 到可用，主窗口
`设计(D)1 - SpaceClaim`（1935×1047，可见、未最小化），内存工作集 **979 MB**，
`scdm_session_close` 之后**残余进程 0 个**。

两点实测提醒：

- **`hidden=true` 不是"最小化"**，PyAnsys 把它映射成 `/Headless=True`，Ansys 的定义是
  **无 UI 的批处理**；实测 40 个顶层窗口里只有 2 个 13×13 无标题小窗，没有主窗口。
- **窗口可能落在副屏**：本机两次可见启动都在 `x = -1927`（副屏）。PyAnsys 不暴露窗口位置，
  要锁主屏得自己往命令行里加 `/WindowLocation=`——**未实测**。

   `server/shutdown-server` 命令，未找到任何等价入口。

ansys-agent-bridge README · 三种安装方式：**在国内、或到 GitHub 的连通性不稳时，请直接用方式 B。** 方式 A 的 `git fetch` 一旦
失败，包内的 `failOnStartupError: false` 会把错误藏起来，自动重连又反复重建环境、重复
导入 `ansys.geometry.core` / `ansys.fluent.core`，占满 DSH 单线程 host 的事件循环——
表现为所有会话历史一直「加载中」、桌面无响应；随后插件管理器会判定「启用它会写出开机
即崩的状态」而把它**锁死为停用**，此后在界面上点开关也启用不回来。
完整机制、诊断命令与解锁步骤见 [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](./TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。

ansys-agent-bridge README · 方式 A：从 GitHub 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ansys-agent-bridge
```

包内声明了 `dsh.bundle`，所以加载器会应用它的 `cordis.patch.yml`：一层 MCP client
注册 `ansys` 服务器。重启 profile 后调用 `ansys_bridge_doctor` 即可。

卸载就是反过来：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove ansys-agent-bridge
```

ansys-agent-bridge README · 环境变量：| 变量 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_UV` | 自动探测 | `uv` 的路径，供 DSH patch 的启动命令使用。 |
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_PRELOAD` | `1` | 启动时就把 Ansys 客户端导入好。设 `0` 可以快速启动，代价是第一次调用 SpaceClaim 时才付这个导入时间。 |
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_TRANSPORT` | `stdio` | `stdio`、`sse` 或 `streamable-http`。 |
| `ANSYS_BRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL` | `WARNING` | FastMCP 请求日志；`INFO` 会每个请求打一行。 |

ansys-agent-bridge README · 为什么启动时要预导入、以及为什么工具是串行的：FastMCP 的同步工具**跑在事件循环线程上**
（`mcp/server/fastmcp/utilities/func_metadata.py`：`return fn(**args)`，没有
`to_thread`）。实测在工具调用里惰性导入 `ansys.geometry.core`，会让整个进程卡死在
numpy 的 C 扩展 `create_module` 里，**既不抛异常也不超时**——客户端看到的是一个永远
不返回的工具调用：

```
_call_with_frames_removed (<frozen importlib._bootstrap>:488)
create_module (<frozen importlib._bootstrap_external>:1321)
<module> (numpy\_core\multiarray.py:11)
...

同一个导入放在进程启动时只要 **0.9 s**，所以 `main()` 在接受请求之前就把 numpy 和两
个 Ansys 客户端导入完。上面的栈是用 `py-spy dump` 抓的。
section: 为什么启动时要预导入、以及为什么工具是串行的

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · 为什么启动时要预导入、以及为什么工具是串行的：同一件事也意味着**长工具会阻塞服务器**：启动 SpaceClaim 的 30 秒会占住事件循环，并发
的调用只能排队。这在这里是可接受的——SpaceClaim 操作的是同一份设计，串行本来就是你
想要的——也正是 DSH patch 里 `toolCallTimeoutMs` 设成 900 s 而不是默认 60 s 的原因。
section: 为什么启动时要预导入、以及为什么工具是串行的

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · 安全约定：- **绝不要打开用户已经在 SpaceClaim GUI 里打开的文件，也绝不要写回源模型。**
  打开、操作、导出到新路径。
- 会话占用一个许可，用完调 `scdm_session_close`。
- **attach 会话不占新许可，也不许被关掉。** 那是用户自己启动的 SpaceClaim：`scdm_session_close`
  在该模式下被硬拒绝，断开只能用 `scdm_detach`。这条护栏在**工具层**实现，不依赖库的默认
  行为（库只在 `product_instance` 非空时才关后端，而 `force_exit()` 之类路径并不看这个字段）。
- 包版本探测只读元数据。早先的版本在工具调用里 `import` 了
  `ansys.fluent.core` 来读版本号，而该库在导入时会打印内容，污染 stdio 的
  JSON-RPC 流并导致会话中途断开；现在 `package_version()` 只读元数据、不导入。

ansys-agent-bridge README · 目录结构：仓库按产品域严格二分：SpaceClaim 的东西和 Fluent 的东西不共用一个目录，连测试脚本都分开。

```
package.json            DSH bundle 清单（`dsh.bundle.patch`）+ npm 入口
cordis.patch.yml        bundle 的 patch 层
TROUBLESHOOTING.md      桌面端装不上／把桌面卡死／MCP 关掉后无法启用回来的排查与解锁
screenshots.json

`dev/` 放开发期材料，**刻意留在仓库内**，这样任何东西都不会写进你的模型目录。transcript、导出产物、复制的测试模型已被 gitignore；测试脚本与 API 盘点结果保留。

根目录只留必须在根的东西：npm 只从根读 `package.json`，`dsh.bundle.patch` 的 `./cordis.patch.yml` 也是相对根解析。

ansys-agent-bridge README · 实现了什么、没实现什么：[`spaceclaim/docs/feature-coverage.md`](spaceclaim/docs/feature-coverage.md) 是与官方 API 的逐项对照表：每个能力域、是否实现、以及未实现的原因。它不是"服务器能做什么"的清单，而是读者用来找"它没做什么"的清单。

最要紧的一条结论是：**官方客户端声明的方法远多于这个版本能跑的**。286 个带 `@min_backend_version` 门槛的公开方法里，**只有 15 个能在 24R2 上调用**，另外 271 个需要 25.1 到 27.1，其中包括 `GeometryCommands` 全部 44 个建模方法。所以对照表先按版本过滤——这一步才分得清"真缺漏"和"调了只会抛 `GeometryRuntimeError` 的方法"。

规划工作前需要知道的两条：
section: 实现了什么、没实现什么

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · 实现了什么、没实现什么：- **几何体检现在是主打功能。** `RepairTools` 里有 8 个 `find_*` 方法完全没有版本门槛，24R2 可用，这 8 项现在都在 `scdm_inspect_geometry` 里。对着那个建网失败的装配体，它直接点名原因：两对完全重合的面，每对分别是 stator 和 pip 上的一个面，面积完全相同。把"建网失败"换成"这两张面叠在一起了"，就是它的全部意义。
- **外流场计算域无法通过这个 API 生成。** 三个 `create_*_enclosure` 需要 26.1.0。做外部流场 CFD 时，计算域要在 SpaceClaim 界面建，或改用 Fluent Meshing 的 enclosure 功能。

text:
ansys-agent-bridge README · 开发：```sh
node tools/verify-patch.mjs        # 不需要任何 profile
uv run --directory python pytest -q
```

`spaceclaim/python/tests/` 里的单测是**离线**的：不打 ANSYS、不占许可、不联网。它们用一个
假的 PyAnsys 客户端记录"服务器愿意发起哪些调用"——这正是两种 GUI 模式的实质（`hidden` 默认值、
attach 必须传 `transport_mode` 而**不能**传 `product_instance`、attach 下 `close()` 必须在碰到
库之前就被拒、参数校验必须在联网之前完成）。当前 **70 项**。

ansys-agent-bridge README · 开发：`verify-patch.mjs` 把 patch 里任何 `!!js` 表达式放在一个**只有 `ctx` 的裸作用域**里求值——这正是 CLI 的构造方式——并拒绝返回 Promise，所以"只能在较新 harness 上启动"的 patch 会在这里失败，而不是在用户机器上。它还会校验 patch 启动的 console script 确实是 `pyproject.toml` 里声明的那个。
